loss_of_function.disease_state: PLP1 absent or non-functional; axonal degeneration without demyelination
loss_of_function.target_state: Restore PLP1 expression toward physiological level
loss_of_function.overshoot_risk: Exceeding the band recreates the duplication phenotype (Karim et al. 2007, Glia)

duplication.disease_state: PLP1 overexpressed; protein accumulates in endolysosomes/autophagic vacuoles; MBP reduced
duplication.target_state: Reduce PLP1 dosage toward physiological level

misfolding_confirmed.disease_state: PLP1 expressed but ER-retained; UPR/ER-stress active; oligodendrocyte death
misfolding_confirmed.target_state: Improve folding/trafficking efficiency or dampen chronic UPR signalling
misfolding_confirmed.overshoot_risk: Systemic UPR inhibition is dangerous — the UPR is essential in secretory tissues

misfolding_uncertain.disease_state: Pathogenic but structurally mild (ddG <= 1.5) — mechanism not resolved by folding-stability alone
misfolding_uncertain.target_state: Undetermined — needs functional validation before a target can be defined
